facts.fact: L'Essor reports that Mali's civil-service HR system SIGRH, with enrolment run from May 2022 to September 2024 and continuing in 2026, is used to validate state agents and decide whether salaries are paid, with 36,151 workers flagged as fictitious and salaries suspended for some agents who had not validated their biometric check; the document gives no event date beyond its publication date of 2026-02-20.
